description: This file defines a helper class `DdlToPdfHelper` which provides static methods for converting MigraDoc documents and DDL strings/files into PDF format, as well as utilities for handling PDF files such as copying pages and appending results. It is part of test helpers used for generating or verifying PDF outputs in tests.

classes.name: DdlToPdfHelper
classes.description: A helper class that offers static methods for creating PDFs from MigraDoc documents, DDL strings/files, and for manipulating PDF files for testing and result collection.

methods.name: CreatePdfFromDocument
methods.description: Creates a PDF file from a MigraDoc Document object, saves it, and returns the filename.

methods.name: CreatePdfFromMdddlFile
methods.description: Reads a .mdddl file, converts it into a MigraDoc Document, and creates a PDF from it.

methods.name: CreatePdfFromDdlString
methods.description: Converts a DDL string into a MigraDoc Document and then into a PDF.

methods.name: FindReferenceFile
methods.description: Finds a referenced PDF file based on a source directory and test name.

methods.name: CreateOrOpenResultFile
methods.description: Creates a new or opens an existing PDF document for results or testing purposes.

methods.name: CopyPdfPage
methods.description: Copies a single page from a source PDF form to a graphics object at a specified rectangle.

methods.name: AppendToResultPdf
methods.description: Appends PDF pages and images to a result PDF file for comparison or record-keeping, supporting side-by-side or separate files.
